integrity: Exact algebraic proof with standalone integer Walsh transform reproduction, self-contained from definitions.
scientific_limitations: Only connected nonempty induced vertex sets in labelled complete multipartite graphs with at least two nonempty parts are treated.
The formula is for unnormalized real counting convolution on a binary group; other normalization conventions rescale singular values.
Finite tests do not establish the all-parameter result; the proof is symbolic.
Absolute historical priority is not established and independent external audit is not performed.
title: Parity-rigid Walsh recovery from connected vertex sets of complete multipartite graphs
